```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)

```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- read_rds("data/imdb_snapshots.rds")

imdb_snapshots

imdb_snapshots |>
  count(snap_year)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022)) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```
